learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion of the module, students will be able to reliably calculate stresses and deformations of rod-shaped elastic components for all types of loads (tension/compression, temperature, bending, shear, torsion) and apply the acquired knowledge to dimension mechanical components safely, functionally, and economically.
They will also be able to analyze the strength behavior of components under combined loading, identify buckling-prone rods, and evaluate their stability behavior.

syllabus_topics: Calculation of stresses and deformations under tensile/compressive stress
